item.description: EAGAN, Minn. item.title: St. Scholastica Men’s Hoops Unable to Contain First Place Gustavus Adolphus on Home Floor
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The St. Scholastica men’s basketball team saw their two-game winning streak come to a close on Wednesday as they fell to Gustavus Adolphus, 92 to 56. CSS was led by Koy Nelson, who had 18 points in the contest. The Saints will try to bounce back on Saturday at Carleton College. Categories: College, Sports
